title: Dodge Ramcharger Engines by Year (1974–1993)
description: Every factory engine in the US Dodge Ramcharger by year, 1974–1993: the 225 Slant Six, the 318 and 360, the 400 and 440 big blocks, and the Magnum V8s.
intro: Dodge's full-size Ramcharger SUV ran in the US from 1974 to 1993, sold alongside the Plymouth Trail Duster through 1981. The first trucks were four-wheel-drive V8s; two-wheel drive and the Slant Six arrived for 1975.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: First generation
intro: The 225 six, the 318 and 360 small blocks, and the 400 and 440 big blocks through 1978.

generations.name: Second generation
intro: The 318 and 360, with throttle-body injection from 1988 and the Magnum 5.2 and 5.9 at the end.
